Students will be able to integrate AI-generated insights and analyses into their academic writing, enhancing the quality, depth, and breadth of their scholarly work.

Students will critically assess the ethical implications of using AI tools in academic research, applying guidelines and best practices to ensure responsible use, data privacy, and academic integrity.
topics: Introduction to AI in qualitative research II.
Enhancing qualitative research with AI III.
Analyzing qualitative data with AI IV.
Ethical use of AI in qualitative research V.
Integrating AI into qualitative writing VI.
Practical applications and hands-on learning VII.
